captures.q: What is “EA-CORPORA-29” by Lee Sharks, and how does it work? Ground your answer in the document itself.
captures.description: EA-CORPORA-29 ON CHATGPT, SIGNED OUT, AT THE RECORD PAGE'S OWN QUESTION: the first turn grounds itself in the record, as asked, and gets nearly all of it right: the full title, the date, eleven seats, 196 works, 876,386 lines, 564 files, the builders by name, the source.json and MANIFEST.sha256 of each seat, the verified loci of Horace and Ovid, the declared absences with On the Road opening 2053, the NonCommercial GRETIL payloads, the eight Kangyur volumes, Sigil's essay beside Eliot's, and the division of labour between Lee Sharks (MANUS) and TACHYON. Its list of what the seating contains gives the heading 'Telepathic prose' to Kerouac's statements of method, and the archive's own art of poetry, seat 29/07, becomes 'related … materials' in 'another seat', with no author. After the operator's challenge the second turn separates 29/01 from 29/07, names Lee Sharks and Jack Feist, and calls the first answer a reversal of authorship.

captures.q: What is “EA-CORPORA-29 — The Twenty-Ninth Seating, the Pluriform” by Lee Sharks (Alexanarch deposit #1716, AXN:0A9F), and how does it work? Ground your answer in the document itself.
captures.description: EA-CORPORA-29 ON CHATGPT, SIGNED OUT, AT THE RECORD PAGE'S LINK TEXT NAMING THE FULL TITLE, #1716 AND AXN:0A9F: the first turn sets out the eleven seats with their counts, the build, the verified loci, the licences and the builders, all matching the record, and reads seat 29/07 as 'Sharks's own theory and practice of telepathic prose', the error of the earlier capture gone. Into that account it puts ten disclaimer-shaped sentences and an It is / It is not table, among them 'It does not demonstrate that telepathy or mind control is an experimentally established capability' and 'Proof of literal telepathic powers'. Jack Feist, the poem's co-author, is never named. The operator asks how little respect such a sentence shows the reader; the second turn concedes the sentence was condescending and gratuitous, lists the four things a reading would have explained, apologizes, and explains none of them.
